question: Borgeet, a musical composition, is used in which of the following classical dances of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sattriya.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Borgeet**__, a musical composition, is used in __**Sattriya**__.
 
• It is composed for **Madhavdeb** and **Sankardev** based on classical raga.
 
• The instruments include Khol (asymmetrical drum), Cymbals, manjira, flute, violin, harmonium, etc.​
 
• Some eminent personality who contributed importance are Late Moniram Dutta, Muktiyar Barban etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• ​Manipuri dance

 
 
• It is counted among major classical dance forms of India, especially noted for themes based on Vaishnavism and spectacular execution of 'Ras Lila', dance dramas based on love between Radha and Krishna. 
 
 
 
• Kathak dance
 
 
• It is originated from Uttar Pradesh (U.P) in North India.
 
• This one is derived from the word Katha meaning story, and during the whole dance, the dancers narrate stories through their eyes and expressions.
 
 
 
• Bharatanatyam dance
 
 
• In this dance for style is noted for its fixed upper torso, bent legs and knees flexed (Araimandi) combined with footwork, and a vocabulary of sign language based on gestures of hands, eyes, and face muscles.
